**[▶ Play in your browser](https://maxcwolf.github.io/pressure-point/)**

**Or download:** `mac-arm64.dmg` for Apple silicon Macs, `mac-x64.dmg` for Intel Macs, `win-x64.exe` for Windows. The other files are what installed apps update from.

Already have the desktop app? It updates itself: it offers to restart once this version has downloaded, or installs it the next time you quit.

First launch on Windows: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
